strings: r_c0 notices that m_c is becoming more dependent and clingy with one of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates, and invites {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to talk about it.
m_c can't stop thinking about one of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates, and cannot bear the thought of not being near them, to the point that it's disrupting {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} duties.

No one understands m_c, apart from that one special cat in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life. At least, that's what {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} thunderous spirit is making {PRONOUN/m_c/object} think. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/refuse/refuses} to be apart from them, and will lash out at any Clanmate that tries to separate them.
